title: Audio to Action Items
description: The starter pipeline for the audio exercise: transcribe a meeting recording with Whisper, then ask an LLM to extract action items as JSON.

steps.description: Import Whisper and load a model. The comments note the install command and that the first run downloads about 1.5 GB for the `medium` model, about 150 MB for `tiny`. The line picks `medium`, with `tiny` for speed and `large` for accuracy as alternatives.
Transcribe the recording and pull the text out of the result. The print line reports the word count and shows the first 200 characters of the transcript.

Build the extraction prompt for the LLM. It asks for all action items and demands only valid JSON with a schema of an `action_items` list, where each item has `description`, `assignee`, and `due_date`. The transcript is pasted verbatim into the prompt.
Send the prompt with `chat.completions.create`. The comment marks `gpt-4o-mini` as a cheaper model for extraction tasks, and `temperature=0` keeps the output deterministic.
Parse the reply with `json.loads`, print the number of action items found, then loop over them and print each description with its owner and due date.
